The wiki's worked example appears to compute a fourth root, but Knock Its Teeth Out at a listed +20% produced +24/+19/+14/+11 from standing openings of 0/24/42/56 against one opponent, which the cube root reproduces to within a point once the weight term is fixed by the first observation

mu_curve.note: mu is a property of OUR card at ITS level, so a fight has nothing to say about it - the only unknown in the opening formula is the opponent's defence weight. It is measured at exactly 1.0 for level 1 by Take Aim, whose cooldown divides by mu and which reports its listed 30. Above level 1 the model carries the stated 1.0-1.5 range as an INTERVAL rather than guessing a curve; a levelled card therefore widens the defence weight it recovers instead of biasing it. Deriving mu from fights was tried and was a second-order inference on the quantity being measured - it moved by a fifth depending only on where a noise threshold sat.
mu_curve.resolve_with: the same move logged at two known card levels

damage_opening_scope.source: Fightsess.java:701-712 - a multi-coloured attack combines 1-prod(1-o) over ITS OWN colours; a single-coloured one reads that one colour. Never the combined opening over all four

opening_display_rounding.source: Buff.java renders (int)floor(ameter()*100); CombatRecorder logs (int)(100*m), the same. An observed opening of 24 means [24,25), so a logged gain carries +/-1 before any other error
